name: Tax
definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters such as thresholds or income.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money resulting from the calculation of the tax.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used for calculation of the tax.

Basis.name: Basis
Basis.definition: Basis used to determine the capital gain or loss, eg, the purchase price.

TaxRateType.name: Tax Rate Type
TaxRateType.definition: Specifies the type of tax rate.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Reference used to identify the nature of tax levied, such as Value Added Tax (VAT).

TaxableBaseAmount.name: Taxable Base Amount
TaxableBaseAmount.definition: Amount of money on which the tax is based.

TaxDate.name: Tax Date
TaxDate.definition: Date by which tax is due.

CertificateIdentification.name: Certificate Identification
CertificateIdentification.definition: Document issued by taxing authority identifying the tax payer.

AdministrationZone.name: Administration Zone
AdministrationZone.definition: Territorial part of a country to which the tax payment is related.

Method.name: Method
Method.definition: Method used to indicate the underlying business or how the tax is paid.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency in which the tax must be settled.

TaxDeduction.name: Tax Deduction
TaxDeduction.definition: Amount of tax that have been previously deducted.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Date on which the tax is calculated.

TaxIdentificationType.name: Tax Identification Type
TaxIdentificationType.definition: Type of tax identification number or identifier.

TaxRateMarker.name: Tax Rate Marker
TaxRateMarker.definition: Specifies the rate of tax levied.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Place of taxation of an individual person or an organisation, where the tax is due.

TaxLiabilityValueCalculation.name: Tax Liability Value Calculation
TaxLiabilityValueCalculation.definition: Net asset value calculation for which tax liability information is provided.

TaxableParty.name: Taxable Party
TaxableParty.definition: Party which is taxable at a specific location

TaxRefundValueCalculation.name: Tax Refund Value Calculation
TaxRefundValueCalculation.definition: Net asset value calculation for which tax refund information is provided.

SecuritiesTransfer.name: Securities Transfer
SecuritiesTransfer.definition: Transfer process for which a tax is specified.

TaxAccount.name: Tax Account
TaxAccount.definition: Account to be used for taxes.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Specifies the adjustments subject to a tax.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest for which a tax is specified.

RelatedPaymentSettlement.name: Related Payment Settlement
RelatedPaymentSettlement.definition: Payment to which the tax applies.

Product.name: Product
Product.definition: Product on which a tax is applied.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Currency exchange applicable to a tax

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a tax and played by a party in that context.

RelatedCorporateActionDistribution.name: Related Corporate Action Distribution
RelatedCorporateActionDistribution.definition: Distribution process for which a tax is specified.

Dividend.name: Dividend
Dividend.definition: Dividend for which a tax is specified.

CorporateActionEvent.name: Corporate Action Event
CorporateActionEvent.definition: Event for which a transaction tax is specified.
